kdde07.title: Libra in Love: Everything Nobody Tells You
kdde07.caption:
Loving a Libra means hearing six plans and booking none of them.
They're weighing it fairly, not stalling. Ask what they want, then actually wait. Save this for your Libra.

kdde08.title: Scorpio in Love: Everything Nobody Tells You
kdde08.caption:
If a Scorpio asks your biggest fear on date one, they're not being intense. They're interested.
Be honest, be patient with the quiet, and show up the same every day. That's how the door opens.

kdde09.title: Sagittarius in Love: Everything Nobody Tells You
kdde09.caption:
A Sagittarius who roasts you a little likes you a lot.
Give them room to roam, ask for the truth with kindness, and be an adventure too. Send this to the Sag who always has a plan B.

kdde10.title: Capricorn in Love: Everything Nobody Tells You
kdde10.caption:
A Capricorn won't always say it. They'll fix your wobbly chair instead.
Notice the steady things, tell them if you need a fix or a hug, and laugh at the dry jokes. They practiced.

kdde11.title: Aquarius in Love: Everything Nobody Tells You
kdde11.caption:
A weird fact at 2 a.m. is an Aquarius saying they thought of you.
Give them space with a promise to come back, and be their friend first. They return closer, maybe with a rock.

kdde12.title: Pisces in Love: Everything Nobody Tells You
kdde12.caption:
Yes, your Pisces cried at the bird outside the window. That's not too much.
Be gentle, say the reassurance out loud, and let the tears happen without rushing to fix them.

kpre07.title: The bus driver waved back
kpre07.caption:
A kid waved at the bus. The driver waved back.
Pisces did not survive this.

kpre08.title: A note in the coat pocket
kpre08.caption:
Ever found a note someone hid in your coat pocket?
Pisces did. The tissue box is empty now.

kpre09.title: They split the last croissant
kpre09.caption:
Two strangers, one last pastry, zero arguments.
Pisces needed a minute. Several, actually.

kpre10.title: Grandpa sent his first heart
kpre10.caption:
Grandpa typed for four minutes to send one heart.
Pisces is still recovering from "is this how".

kpre11.title: The umbrella tilt
kpre11.caption:
Watch who the umbrella tilts toward.
One shoulder soaked, one date dry, one Pisces in pieces.

kpre12.title: Pisces reacts to one whole kind day
kpre12.caption:
Five tiny kind moments in one day. Can you guess which one broke Pisces?
Stay for number five. It's the friend.
